rule: A written resource, like Paper 3 (Alternative to Practical), can teach and test how to plan a practical, the procedure, the readings, their interpretation and the method's limitations. It cannot show that a learner has carried a practical out. An objective worded "design and carry out", "make temporary slides" or "use and manipulate a light microscope" therefore has a hands-on component that no card covers. This file keeps the two apart, objective by objective, so that coverage of an objective by cards is never read as evidence that the hands-on part was done.
